name: Payload Data 2
definition: Identifies the instance of the document exchanged.

PayloadIdentifier.name: Payload Identifier
PayloadIdentifier.definition: String of characters that uniquely identifies the file, which was delivered by the sender.

CreationDateAndTime.name: Creation Date And Time
CreationDateAndTime.definition: Date and time when the file was created by the sender.

PossibleDuplicateFlag.name: Possible Duplicate Flag
PossibleDuplicateFlag.definition: Flag indicating if the file exchanged between the two business applications is possibly a duplicate. If this indicator is not present within the message, please note that the default value would be "False".
